verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the Diplomatic Enclave in Chanakyapuri, New Delhi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel Address:_ Diplomatic Enclave, Chanakyapuri, New Delhi 110 023

verified_facts.text: The hotel stands on Africa Avenue in the Diplomatic Enclave in Chanakyapuri, a neighbourhood home to many embassies.
verified_facts.excerpt: stands grandly on Africa Avenue in the Diplomatic Enclave, in Chanakyapuri. It is an upscale neighbourhood in New Delhi, home to many embassies and dignitaries.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's architecture echoes the grandeur of Lutyens' Delhi, blended with contemporary styling.
verified_facts.excerpt: Echoing the grandeur of Lutyens’ Delhi with a confluence of contemporary styling and magnificent architecture

verified_facts.text: The interiors feature artworks, hand-carved artefacts and brass accents by Indian artists.
verified_facts.excerpt: vibrant artworks, hand-carved artefacts, and brass accents by renowned Indian artists

verified_facts.text: The sunset ceremonial rituals are accompanied by high tea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Witness an ode to India’s rich traditions at sunset, accompanied with an exquisite high tea.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a guided art walk through installations, murals and sculptures by Indian artists.
verified_facts.excerpt: A guided walk, through larger-than-life installations, murals and sculptures, celebrating India's finest artists.

verified_facts.text: At dusk, guests can take part in rituals at the courtyard shrine of the hotel's resident goddess.
verified_facts.excerpt: As dusk descends, partake in the serene rituals that capture the timeless essence of India’s culture at the courtyard shrine of our resident goddess.

verified_facts.text: The ceremonial rituals include a showcase of classical music and dance in the hotel's gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: an immersive showcase of classical music and dance at the opulent gardens

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop temperature-controlled swimming pool on the eleventh floor with views of the city skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: the rooftop pool is Delhi's only temperature-controlled one on the eleventh floor, offering stunning views of the city skyline

verified_facts.text: The Spa offers European and Ayurveda-inspired therapies and holistic treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Leela Palace New Delhi offers the best of European and Ayurveda-inspired therapies and holistic treatments at The Spa.

verified_facts.text: Yoga and meditation sessions can be personalised for groups or private settings, and The Spa has a terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Those inclined towards Yoga and meditation sessions can be personalised both in group and private settings. The spiritual experiences are elevated with the serenity of The Spa's terrace.

verified_facts.text: The spa facilities include a steam room and sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: Steam and sauna

verified_facts.text: Guests receive personalised hospitality services including a dedicated butler.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests at The Leela Palace New Delhi receive personalized hospitality services, including a dedicated butler

verified_facts.text: The suite categories include a Royal Suite with Plunge Pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Royal Suite with Plunge Pool

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms have spa mood lighting, with Ad Notam mirror TVs in specific suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxury bathrooms with spa mood lighting, Ad Notam Mirror TV (in specific suites)

verified_facts.text: Concierge services are Clefs d'Or recognised.
verified_facts.excerpt: Clefs d'or recognised concierge services

verified_facts.text: Jamavar serves royal Indian cuisine from across the country and is home to the Maharaja Table.
verified_facts.excerpt: Jamavar, brings forth the vibrant spirit of royal Indian cuisine from across the country with majestic ambiance and the iconic Maharaja Table

verified_facts.text: Megu serves modern Japanese cuisine and has an outdoor experience called Izakaya at Megu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Megu, the modern Japanese fine-dining restaurant. Also comes with an outdoor experience called Izakaya at Megu.

verified_facts.text: Le Cirque is a Franco-Italian fine-dining restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Le Cirque - Franco-Italian fine-dining restaurant

verified_facts.text: The hotel can arrange half-day or full-day guided tours of Delhi sites such as the Red Fort, India Gate and Qutub Minar.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel can arrange guided tours to some of Delhi’s most iconic spots like the Red Fort, India Gate, and Qutub Minar. The rich history of the city can be explored in a half-day or full-day tour

verified_facts.text: Event spaces include a Grand Ballroom, an adjoining Royal Ballroom and The Terrace with a retractable conservatory.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Terrace with a retractable conservatory

verified_facts.text: The Library Bar pairs literature with mixology.
verified_facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in the world of The Library, where literature meets mixology.
